c: Bring milk, water, butter and salt to the boil; pour onto cornmeal; mix; cool to warm.
Knead in coarsely grated sulguni to a firm dough. Shape 20 × 85 g cakes 1.5 cm thick.
Pan-fry in a little oil at medium heat 4 min a side until crusted and the cheese oozes; core ≥ 72 °C.
55120d3d.st: Best within 1 h. Shaped raw cakes 0–3 °C 24 h.
55120d3d.al: 7 Milk (whole milk, butter, sulguni cheese). Contains milk.

c: Winter morning dish; salt and garlic are added at the table
Singe and scrape the feet; soak with the tripe 24 h in cold water at 0–3 °C, changing it 3 times.
Cover with fresh water; bring to the boil; skim; simmer at 90 °C 8 h, topping up with boiling water, until the meat leaves the bones and the broth is milky.
Lift out; take off the meat; cut tripe in strips; return to the broth. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Crush garlic with a little salt and broth. Crumble dried lavash into the bowls; serve with garlic, salt, radishes and herbs.
ddafdf62.st: Broth 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Freeze −18 °C 3 months.

c: Traditionally slapped onto the wall of a tone; a deck oven with a stone works
Mix flour, water and yeast; rest 30 min; add salt; knead 8 min (dough 24 °C).
Bulk ferment 2 h with 2 folds, then 0–3 °C overnight.
Divide 10 × 250 g; pre-shape; rest 30 min. Stretch into 40 cm canoes with pointed ends and a thick central rim.
Bake on the stone at 250 °C with steam 12–14 min until blistered and golden; core 96 °C.
Individual 14 cm clay ketsi pans preheated in the oven
Remove stems; place caps gill-side up, overlapping, in the hot pans; dot with butter; season.
Bake 220 °C 12 min until juicy; add garlic and grated sulguni; 5 min more until melted and coloured; core ≥ 75 °C.
Scatter coriander; serve sizzling with bread.
d4dc762f.st: Cook to order. Mise en place 0–3 °C 24 h.

c: Knead a firm, smooth dough; rest 30 min; divide into 12.
Use 10–15 kinds of greens in season; 1.5 kg raw greens shrink to about 1 kg
Wash and chop greens finely; season with salt and oil just before filling (they weep).
Roll each dough ball to a 25 cm circle; pile 85 g greens in the centre; pull the edges over and pinch closed; flatten to 2 cm.
Bake on a dry griddle or plancha 4 min a side until spotted and the greens steam through; core ≥ 72 °C.
d40dea4b.st: Best within 1 h. Room temperature 4 h.

c: Knead a firm dough; rest 30 min; roll 1.5 mm; cut 4 cm squares.
Mix lamb with grated onion and seasoning. Place 6 g on each square; pinch two opposite corners, then the others, leaving the top open (boat shape).
Pack tightly in a buttered GN; bake 200 °C 20 min until golden.
Pour hot stock to half-height; bake 15 min more until absorbed; core ≥ 75 °C.
Serve with yoghurt mixed with crushed garlic and brown butter with sumac poured over.
e34bda31.st: Unbaked manti freeze −18 °C 1 month. Baked 0–3 °C 48 h; reheat with stock to ≥ 75 °C.
e34bda31.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (natural yoghurt, butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, celery.

c: Offal must be very fresh; soak kidneys 1 h in cold water
Trim heart and kidneys of fat and tubes; cut all offal in 2 cm pieces, keeping liver separate.
Fry heart and kidneys in butter 6 min over high heat; add liver 3 min; lift out (liver stays pink inside, core ≥ 70 °C 2 min).
Fry onion in half-rings until golden; add diced tomato and garlic 5 min; return the offal; toss 2 min. Season; lemon, herbs.
cf1d46d0.st: Cook to order. Raw offal 0–3 °C 24 h.

c: Cut lamb in 3 cm cubes; brown in ghee; add sliced onion and turmeric; cook 10 min.
Add water; simmer covered 1 h 15 min.
Add fruit, chestnuts, pomegranate molasses and saffron infused in 50 ml hot water; simmer 20 min until the sauce is glossy; core ≥ 75 °C. Balance sweet and sour; season.
e9d113f6.st: Cooled within 90 min, 0–3 °C 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C.

c: 10 skewers × 260 g raw sirloin cubes; grill over vine cuttings or hardwood
Cut beef in 4 cm cubes. Marinate with grated onion and wine 2 h at 0–3 °C (no salt).
Thread tightly; salt just before grilling.
Grill over glowing embers 10–12 min, turning, to medium; core 57 °C (≥ 63 °C if requested).
Slide meat onto plates over thin red onion rings; scatter pomegranate and coriander. Tkemali on the side.
51ea636a.st: Raw marinated meat 0–3 °C 24 h. Grill to order.

c: Mix flour, yoghurt, melted cooled butter, yeast and salt to a soft dough; rest 1 h at 0–3 °C.
Rub flour, soft butter, sugar and vanilla to a moist crumb.
Roll dough 3 mm, 30 × 60 cm; spread the crumb; roll up tightly; flatten slightly; cut 24 diagonal pieces.
Brush with yolk; bake 180 °C 25 min until golden and flaky.
4e9c78ac.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour, plain flour, for filling) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (natural yoghurt, butter, butter, for filling). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.
